notes: Each batch has 10 requests per route and client Accept-Encoding, without retries.
The initial April batch lost raw bytes and CF-Ray for three failed gzip decodes; retained as preliminary evidence.
Tail events are correlated by CF-Ray. Unmatched events are recorded, not inferred.
Compatibility dates and deployment IDs do not identify the managed runtime binary.
The september batch crossed a deployment transition: 5 caller events used the April version and 95 used the September version. It is excluded from the primary comparison.

The primary comparison uses april-repeat and sep: 200 requests with complete response metadata; 191 tail events matched the expected caller versions, and 9 were not captured. The sep batch used a separately named Worker pair to avoid a date transition.
